title: Sounding the Depths
description: A Historian has pointed you toward the Fathoms nautical trail. Begin with the system's own first fishing step: use bait and let the water answer.
description_completed: The baited line has done its work. The Historian now wants proof that the stranger catches are more than stories.

dialogue.offer: If you mean to understand these waters, start with method. Bait the hook, use it properly, then return.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: Good. The first observation is recorded. Now we can ask what else is taking the bait.
dialogue.completed: Bait first. Then the unusual catches.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign
